title: Repair the existing Closed-Loop Reliability application
description: A genuine project record for the current application repair. It records only work and evidence that actually exist. It intentionally stops at the first control that has not genuinely been satisfied instead of fabricating completed independent runs or release evidence.
nextRequiredAction: Create ten genuinely independent fresh execution contexts from the frozen candidate. Do not count synthetic or duplicated records as independent runs.
latestEvidenceReference: Existing repository source, supplied screenshots, controlling application description, and TEST_PROJECT.json

userEnteredData.requestedOutput: Repair the existing application in place so the running product is one coherent human-facing phone-first closed-loop reliability application.
humanUiRequirements: Normal mobile-sized controls rather than giant buttons
Project information surfaced where the human needs it
No developer-console or agent-control-panel primary UI
testProjectRequirements: The test project is a real project inside the application, not the application itself
The test project uses the same persisted project model as ordinary projects
Generated instructions, user-entered data, outputs, evidence and history are inspectable
The project must not claim independent runs or release completion that did not actually occur

objective.exactUserObjective: Repair the existing application in place. Keep one application only. Implement the 30-stage workbook and Appendices A-F semantically as a human-facing phone-first project workflow, restore a genuine fully inspectable test project, preserve all meaningful project data and generated artifacts, correct the oversized/cluttered UI, and do not claim completion unless the result is visible and usable in the running application.
objective.deliverable: The existing GitHub Pages application, corrected in place; no second application or parallel implementation.
objective.requiredOutputFormat: One phone-first web application using the existing repository entry point.

availableTools: Browser runtime used by the deployed application
prohibitedActions: Do not create a replacement or second application
Do not delete required workflow semantics because a prior UI treatment was poor
Do not fabricate completed independent runs, audits, hashes or release acceptance
Do not make raw implementation bookkeeping the primary human interface

unknowns.unknownFact: Ten genuinely independent execution contexts have not yet been supplied to this static application project.
unknowns.whyItMatters: Stage 11 requires ten independent executions before Stage 12 can truthfully verify them.
unknowns.resolutionPath: Launch ten fresh external contexts from the frozen Stage 11 instruction and record each output separately.

tests.procedure: Count root HTML entry points and inspect script loading.
Render the live app at phone width and inspect control sizing, project hierarchy and progressive disclosure.
Inspect runtime stage inventory and stage opening behavior.

Open the built-in test project and inspect persisted state, current blocker and complete recorded project data.
tests.expectedResult: Real project state with truthful incomplete status.

tests.procedure: Open Project data and History and inspect generated prompts and saved outputs.
tests.expectedResult: Generated material remains visible on demand.

mutations.violationMode: Make stage navigation large full-width cards on the primary screen.

Mark ten independent runs complete without actual independent contexts.

productionInstruction.objective: Repair and inspect the existing application without creating another application.
procedure: Keep index.html as the sole application entry point.
Retain the existing 30-stage workflow runtime and its semantic controls.
Replace primary-screen workbook/checklist presentation with a compact project-oriented human interface.
Expose detailed stage controls only when the user opens a stage workspace.
Integrate appendix semantics into Runs, Issues, Release, New project and output/history behavior.
Load the test project into the ordinary persisted project state and expose all actually recorded work.
Do not claim independent execution, verification, convergence, baseline or release evidence that has not actually occurred.
Verify repository structure and live phone rendering before claiming completion.
productionInstruction.failureBehavior: When a mandatory control is unavailable, preserve UNKNOWN/BLOCKED and stop affected downstream work.
productionInstruction.completionCriteria: All mandatory requirements are affirmatively established by repository and live-render evidence; no critical or major defect remains.

generatedPrompts.title: Initialize job
generatedPrompts.prompt: Preserve the exact repair objective, one-app constraint, supplied screenshots, full controlling description, prohibited actions, unknowns and required output form. Do not paraphrase away material requirements.

generatedPrompts.title: Source inventory
generatedPrompts.prompt: Inspect the actual repository files, supplied screenshots and controlling description. Record source authority, inspection state, relevant portions and conflicts.

generatedPrompts.title: Requirements research
generatedPrompts.prompt: Extract every material UI, workflow, test-project, evidence, appendix, blocking, history and verification requirement from the controlling sources. Preserve exceptions and dependencies.

generatedPrompts.title: Atomic requirements
generatedPrompts.prompt: Convert the researched obligations into independently testable requirements with observable satisfaction and failure conditions.

generatedPrompts.title: Resolve requirement set
generatedPrompts.prompt: Check the requirements for conflicts, unsupported strengthening, undefined terms, missing prerequisites and absent verification paths. Preserve the intended semantics.

generatedPrompts.title: Verification suite
generatedPrompts.prompt: Create verification procedures before production instruction authoring. Prefer deterministic repository checks for structural properties and live rendering for representation properties.

generatedPrompts.title: Failure tests
generatedPrompts.prompt: Construct failure cases for giant primary controls, appendix checklist walls and fabricated independent-run completion. The validators must reject these cases.

generatedPrompts.title: Production instruction
generatedPrompts.prompt: Repair only the existing app. Preserve the 30-stage engine, replace primary-screen raw workbook treatment with a human project interface, integrate appendix semantics contextually, restore a truthful inspectable test project, and verify live mobile rendering.

generatedPrompts.title: Preflight instruction
generatedPrompts.prompt: Audit the production instruction for ambiguity, hidden deletion of required semantics, unverifiable claims, missing failure behavior and unclear responsibility. Do not execute the target work during preflight.

generatedPrompts.title: Freeze candidate
generatedPrompts.prompt: Freeze the exact application source, test-project data, verifier and tool configuration used for the iteration. A material change terminates the batch and creates a new candidate.

generatedPrompts.title: Ten independent executions
generatedPrompts.prompt: Create ten genuinely fresh execution contexts using the identical frozen candidate and instruction. Do not show any run another run's output, reviewer feedback, failure explanation or proposed correction. Save each output separately. If ten independent contexts are unavailable, return BLOCKED rather than fabricating them.
